data.name: Fanterra: A Fantasy Farming Adventure
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

You’ve been plucked from your world and dropped into the land of Fanterra, a mysterious place filled with magic, beauty, and ever-expanding potential. But you’re not the only one — alongside others who’ve also been transported here, you’ll work to build a thriving community and uncover the truth about who brought you here... and why.

Fanterra: A Fantasy Farming Adventure is a cozy, single-player sandbox life sim where you can gather, mine, build and adventure in a seamless, procedurally generated pixel-art world. Construct homes and villages, explore vast biomes, befriend NPCs, and piece together the mystery behind this magical land. Whether you're creating your ideal peaceful farm or venturing deep into caves in search of treasure, Fanterra: A Fantasy Farming Adventure offers a laid-back yet boundless adventure.

The world is infinite.

What will you make of it?

Key Features

  • Explore infinite procedurally-generated terrain with a wide range of biomes: discover deserts, temperate forests, rainforests, boreal mountains, and magical forests — each with their own unique creatures, flora, and fauna. 

  • Experience dynamic weather, beautiful sunsets, and four seasons in temperate-zone biomes

  • Craft tools, equipment, and building blocks to expand your farm and power up your character

  • Learn new skills, gain experience, and level up your abilities as you play

  • Build block-by-block with seamless autotiling and unique blocks like sloped roofs and different house materials to make your architectural dreams a reality

  • Fish, farm and spelunk for resources

  • Sword, shield, bow, and magic-based combat

  • Capture and care for a variety of farm animals

  • Grow 32 unique crops

  • Meet NPCs who have also been transported to this new world. Take on quests, engage in branching stories, shop, trade — and maybe even fall in love.

  • Experience a world-bending camera for immersive vistas and painterly perspectives

  • Customize your character with:

    • 9 complete outfits

    • Mix-and-match clothing (tops, bottoms, hats, armor, etc.)

    • 17 hairstyles with 56 colors

    • 11 eye colors and 18 skin tones

*Note: Some customization features are dependent on Kickstarter funding.

  • Start new worlds with different seeds for endless replayability

Planned Features (Kickstarter Stretch Goals)

[These are features that I would love to add to Fanterra but require more dedicated time to implement, and so they are planned as Kickstarter stretch goals.] 

  • Create your own RPG storyline with the ability to share it on the Steam Workshop for other people to play. Create and share custom quests, NPCs, and events. Add your own items to your RPG story with their own crafting recipes and stats.

  • Underwater exploration.

  • Online peer-to-peer multiplayer. Host and join worlds with friends.

  • More crafting options, from weapons and tools to spells and enchantments.

  • Mounts and rideable creatures and tools, beginning with horses but with potential for eagles, dragons and broomsticks. 

  • Custom texture pack support.

  • Lava and additional cave features

  • Additional biomes Including magical rainforests, deep oceans, and more

  • Continental terrain generation (land separated by larger bodies of water than current generation)

  • Boats for navigating larger bodies of water

  • More character customization including outfits, accessories and visual flair

  • Romance and family-building

  • Expanded animal husbandry

  • Structure blueprint system, so you can save and reuse structures like houses across worlds

data.short_description: Jump into this cozy sandbox life sim where you explore an infinite magical world, gather resources, and build freely in a beautiful pixel-art landscape. Befriend otherworldly NPCs and grow a thriving community while uncovering the mystery of how you got here.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (7th Gen) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel Iris Plus / UHD 620 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8th Gen) or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
